title: filter_genes
description:
Filter genes based on number of counts or cells.

Keep genes that have at least min_counts counts or are expressed in at least
min_cells cells, or at most max_counts counts or are expressed in at most
max_cells cells. At least one threshold must be provided.

Wraps the rapids-singlecell rsc.pp.filter_genes function.

modality.description: Which modality from the input MuData file to process.

layer.description: Layer of counts to filter on

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata
objects

min_counts.description: Minimum number of counts required for a gene to pass filtering.

min_cells.description:
Minimum number of cells expressing a gene required for it to pass
filtering.

max_counts.description: Maximum number of counts allowed for a gene to pass filtering.

max_cells.description:
Maximum number of cells expressing a gene allowed for it to pass
filtering.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
